scope: Read-only review of Task05 report, checkpoint selection, measured timing, final resource gates and delivery order; this is not execution of the finalizer or model audit.

checks.section6_eight_rows: Selected checkpoint, base, bm25 and oracle, each in reselect and append mode at mid budget 2814; eight rows, 249 heldout train tasks per row.
checks.checkpoint_pooling: Each of five checkpoints requires all six mode/budget cells with 249 tasks each. Primary loss count is tasks missing at least one gold passage at the final state; pooled denominator is 1494 task-mode-budget trajectories, with 249 underlying independent tasks.
checks.checkpoint_tie_break: Ascending pooled evidence-loss count, descending pooled final-recall mean, ascending checkpoint step. Evaluation loss does not select the checkpoint.
checks.metric_denominators: Report preserves count/n for rates, n for means, step versus task macro denominators, question counts, 1494 pooled counts, 249 cell counts, and one-run timing denominators. Strategy validation checks metric counts, finite values, rate consistency and pooled sums/means.
checks.truthful_pending: Missing measurements or artifacts keep report pending; malformed completed evidence fails. At review time final training/model/resource evidence is still incomplete.
checks.final_lifecycle_gate: Requires formal 2500 optimizer steps, 40000 sample exposures, epoch 2, five saved checkpoints, six complete model strategies and watcher evaluation_complete with exit_code 0. Exact recorded task and watcher PIDs must have exited before inventory.
checks.final_resource_gate: Current physical GPU 1 UUID must match preflight/history; memory_used_mib must be below 2048 and no recorded task PID may remain in nvidia-smi compute processes. Root growth is current raw df used bytes minus the original preflight root_df_used_bytes, limited to 300000000 bytes without offsetting or resetting the baseline.
checks.inventory_publication: Full external inventory is deferred until completion/process/resource gates pass, then completion evidence, PID source evidence and current GPU/df are rechecked before successful receipts are published.
checks.checksum_chain: Task05 checksum finalization checks frozen old Task01-04 content and final external inventory coverage; it must run after the final Task05 documents and receipts exist.

delivery_notes.instruction: Allow an initial build exit code 2 when the final loss CSV or matching SVG receipt is pending, then plot, then build again. Do not use an unconditional first-build && plot chain. Exit 1 indicates failed evidence and must not be ignored. Final delivery requires build exit 0.

delivery_notes.train_seconds: CUDA-synchronized on_train_begin to CUDA-synchronized on_train_end, including all five scheduled evaluations and checkpoint saves for formal training.
delivery_notes.wall_seconds: Worker work interval starts after initial GPU checks, input hashes/JSON checks, source snapshot and initial config writes, but before torch/Swift imports, model startup and sample encoding. It ends after requesting and joining the monitor, before final worker_result/config writes. It is not the full OS process lifetime.
delivery_notes.instruction: Final report and delivery prose must describe these measured intervals accurately. Do not change the running training source.

Wait for training, all six model rollouts, inference shutdown and watcher exit before independent final model audit and final inventory/resource acceptance. Current read-only review does not certify actual GPU release or final root-disk growth.
